Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner unnecessarily constrained the task to US-only release dates and even instructed to use the latest US date as “canonical,” which is misaligned with the question asking which film released earlier. This over-narrowing and incorrect criterion could lead to a wrong comparison (and the Planner also asserted a 2013 US date for Xenoa without verification). The correct approach is to compare earliest release dates (globally), where Xenoa (2007) clearly precedes Divorce Invitation (2012/2013).
